title: Deployment Reproducibility Evidence Bundle v1
description: Raw, committed measurement evidence backing a reproducibility manifest (see reproducibility.schema.json's evidenceFile). Contains ONLY captured facts — live on-chain runtime bytecode (read via a public RPC) and two independently-captured compiler builds (pinned to the historical deployment commit, and to current public HEAD), each with solc's own deployedBytecode.object and immutableReferences verbatim. This file does NOT contain any derived verdict (no match/hash/verified booleans) — those are computed deterministically and offline from this evidence by scripts/lib/reproducibility-evidence.ts every time `npm run validate:reproducibility` runs, so they can never drift from what this file actually contains.

subject.description: The deployed contract name (matches the corresponding manifest's subject).

liveRuntime.description: A genuine external measurement: the live on-chain runtime bytecode, captured via a public RPC read. Not derived — replayed byte-for-byte.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the RPC read.

deploymentCommitBuild.description: Compiled from a worktree pinned to the exact historical deployment commit, using that commit's own committed lockfile/toolchain.

publicHeadBuild.description: Compiled from current public HEAD at capture time, using the repo's current lockfile/toolchain — a distinct capture from deploymentCommitBuild, since the toolchain can (and here, did) drift between the two commits.

immutableIdentities.description: Only present for contracts with `immutable` variables. One entry per compiler-reported immutable AST id (not per physical byte-range reference — a single immutable can be referenced at multiple PUSH sites; see deploymentCommitBuild.immutableReferences for the physical offsets).

astId.description: The solc AST node id of the VariableDeclaration, as a string (matches a key in immutableReferences).

derivation.description: The exact public-input computation the checker re-runs to derive this immutable's expected 32-byte value. See scripts/lib/reproducibility-evidence.ts deriveImmutableExpectedBytes for the implementation of every method.

expectedValueHex.description: Pinned expected value, for auditability. The checker independently recomputes this from `derivation` and fails if it disagrees with what's pinned here, so this can never silently drift from the derivation it claims to record.

deployedBytecodeObject.description: solc's own evm.deployedBytecode.object, verbatim, 0x-prefixed. Zero-filled at any immutable byte ranges (solc's own convention for the pre-patch template).

immutableReferences.description: solc's own evm.deployedBytecode.immutableReferences, verbatim, keyed by AST node id (as a string). Empty object for a contract with no `immutable` variables.
